title: Chapter 45 Alliance
content:
Chapter 45 Alliance

Wu Qing nodded seriously and said, "Great minds think alike!"

"The main purpose of my visit this time is to discuss with you about the formation of a united front among the major territories."

"We must continue to fight the war with the bear goblins, but we are not familiar with the situation in this area."

"If we can form a team and hold together, with your support in all aspects, our battle will be fought clearly and our goals will be clearer."

"Just like what you said just now, I have a clear understanding of the situation in this area, which is very important for how we should act next!"

"Your idea is very good. If we can win the qualification for independent development through this war, it will certainly be the best thing!"

Meng was very happy to get Wu Qing's affirmative reply.

"So, you agree? Do we need to draw up a charter for the specific cooperation?"

"We in Daxia lack everything except soldiers. We will be the main force in the battle, and you can arrange everything else!"

"How can this be? The Zerg has the support of the Overlord. Your Daxia can be said to be the one with the most profound backing among our territories. You should lead us in our actions!"

Wu Qing took the initiative to give up the dominant position because he was optimistic about Meng's ability. Meng is a man who can accomplish things.

It doesn't really matter whether the Zerg has the dominant position in this small alliance that is about to be formed. As long as the Zerg is strong enough, what Wu Qing says is the most important.

If he wants this title, he will have to take care of a lot of things. It is better to just fight the war. He is not afraid of being harmed by others. Strength is the real guarantee of power.

"To be honest, there are few talents available in our Great Xia Territory, and we know nothing about the surrounding situation."

"I am powerless to contact all parties and manage and coordinate this alliance."

"The influence of the Tiger Territory in various territories is not weak, and I believe in your ability. It is most appropriate to leave these things to you."

Wu Qing explained to Meng sincerely.

"Okay! Since you said so, I will give it a try!"

"In this world, strength is respected. With the strength of you and the Zerg, if we really succeed in the future, we will still rely on you!"

Meng thought about it and agreed with Wu Qing's suggestion, and bluntly pointed out the relationship between strength and status.

"Let's talk about the future later. You and I have similar personalities. If there is anything that cannot be decided, we can discuss it together. It's not a big problem."

Wu Qing said with a smile.

The two smiled at each other, stretched out their right hands, and held the two hands, one big and one small, tightly together.

The intention of the alliance was decided, and the two of them ate and drank again. Wu Qing used a substitute, so he was more relaxed and accompanied Meng to enjoy a pure meat meal.

After dinner, it was late at night, and the two talked by candlelight and discussed many details.

Meng called people in one after another and arranged various tasks overnight.

Time was very tight. Wu Qing and Meng both believed that there would definitely be a big battle tomorrow, but they could not determine the target of the attack of the bear goblins for the time being.

As long as it was not the main force attacking the Tengu tribe, Wu Qing would choose to participate in the battle and would not let the bear goblins attack other territories.

Meng also agreed with this view. These territories are now potential allies. After tomorrow's battle, as long as they show momentum, the alliance's affairs may become very simple.

In this battle, the main force of the Tengu tribe will definitely not take the initiative to participate in the battle, so everything can only rely on themselves.

Meng originally had little confidence in getting through this crisis. The appearance of Wu Qing gave him great hope. As long as there is a need, he is willing to fight.

"I will personally gather the army in a moment. Tomorrow morning, I will go out of the city with you to fight!"

"You don't need to go out of the city to fight. The Tiger Territory is now the pillar of this area. You defending the city is the greatest contribution."

Meng is ready to devote all the city's strength to fight tomorrow's battle. He guessed from the number of Zerg troops brought by Wu Qing that the Zerg's military strength should not be comparable to that of the Bugbears.

Wu Qing does not want to fight together with other armies for the time being. Allies with weak combat power will only drag the Zerg back and affect the Zerg's strategy and tactics.

Moreover, the Zerg also wants to monopolize the resources and luck brought by the enemy.

"No! You Zerg cannot fight alone!"

Meng's attitude is very firm.

Wu Qing felt a little headache. He thought for a while and said to Meng: "You don't have to worry about the lack of Zerg troops. The Zerg's support is endless. There is no problem in dealing with the bear goblins."

"If you really want to join the war, send a mobile and powerful force to join the war."

"The Zerg's fighting style is very crazy. If your general troops join the war, the casualties will be very serious."

Meng listened to Wu Qing's persuasion, was silent for a while, and then responded: "Okay! Tomorrow I will lead the Tiger Cavalry to join the war with you!"

"I want to see the Zerg's fighting style with my own eyes!"

"Let you see the fighting style of our tiger people!"

Wu Qing has seen Meng's stubborn temper. Fearing that he will misunderstand, he explained again: "The Zerg race is a little special. After they die, they will return to the side of the master."

"So, death is not the end for them, but a new beginning."

"Therefore, they fight fearlessly and fearlessly, and there are many ways of fighting that we ordinary races cannot accept."

"You will understand when you see it tomorrow."

He waved his hands and said with a smile: "Haha, you don't need to explain, I understand what you mean!"

"So, the Zerg's view of life and death is somewhat similar to those of believers in the gods."

"Then it's settled, we'll see you on the battlefield tomorrow!"

"Don't underestimate our warriors of the Tiger clan!"

Wu Qing could only nod in agreement.

Next, the two discussed the problem and chatted. Wu Qing obtained a lot of useful information from the chat with Meng.

Meng was also impressed by Wu Qing's extensive knowledge and unique way of thinking.

It was late at night and everything was arranged. Wu Qingcai said goodbye to Meng and went to the residence arranged by Meng himself to rest.

After the substitute fell asleep, Wu Qing regained consciousness and adjusted the development direction of the Zerg territory according to the latest situation.

The Zerg's combat arms, the number of Hydralisks has reached 1,000, and the number of puppies is only 6,000. Even fewer can participate in the battle, and they need to continue to increase.

From now on, as long as there are enough energy resources, the Zerg territory will always hatch puppies, striving to have enough troops to deal with the first battle tomorrow.

As long as the war breaks out and sufficient resources are provided, the Zerg troops will continue to grow.

"I'm lucky. Meeting a lord like Meng saved me a lot of things."

Wu Qing is very optimistic about Meng. With the support of him and the Zerg behind him, there is no telling how far this small alliance that has not yet been formed will eventually develop.

Wu Qing was looking forward to it.
